Interface GameCommand

All Superinterfaces:
ClientCommand, Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
ChooseColorCommand, DrawCardCommand, EndTurnCommand, PlaceTotemCommand
public interface GameCommand extends ClientCommand
Family of commands that mutate the state of an ongoing game (choose colour, place totem, draw card, end turn). It adds a second dispatch level towards GameCommandVisitor, while the top-level dispatch always routes to ClientCommandVisitor.visit(GameCommand).
